name: contentful-backup-lambda
description: Backup Lambda: exports Contentful, archives, stages, verifies and promotes to S3
//dependencyPins: archiver is held at 7.0.1 DELIBERATELY. 7.0.1 carries zero npm advisories and is CommonJS. archiver 8.0.0 is pure ESM ("type": "module") and exports Archiver/ZipArchive CLASSES with no callable default, so `require('archiver')` then `archiver('zip', ...)` — the form used in index.js and deploy/build-lambda.js — no longer works. Taking 8.x means rewriting the archive path in two files to a class API and reopening the ESM conversion this project deliberately avoided (contentful-export 8.x ships CJS precisely so no conversion was needed). No security benefit, real regression risk to the backup archive itself. Revisit only if an advisory lands on 7.x, or as a deliberate, separately-tested migration.
